The '''GR491''' is the reference guide for the responsible design of digital services, published by the Institute for Sustainable IT (INR).

== Scope ==

Unlike the [[RGESN]], the GR491 is not limited to environmental [[Ecodesign|ecodesign]]. It also covers the social and ethical dimensions of [[Sustainable IT|sustainable IT]]: [[Digital accessibility|accessibility]], protection of personal data, and avoidance of deceptive interfaces.

Its name comes from the number of recommendations in its first version.

== Structure ==

Eight families follow the life cycle of a digital service: strategy, specifications, UX/UI, content, architecture, frontend, backend and hosting.

It contains '''61 recommendations''' broken down into '''516 criteria'''.

== Licence ==

The GR491 is published under the Etalab Open Licence v2.0, which permits reuse, distribution and adaptation. It is available online and maintained collaboratively.
